prompt_text: I need a personal injury attorney in Chicago after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Here are several Chicago-area personal-injury firms you should consider calling after a car accident, with why each is worth contacting. These firms are all established, handle automobile/catastrophic-injury cases, and are known for trial experience and negotiating with insurers.

- Clifford Law Offices — well-known for high-profile, catastrophic auto-accident and wrongful-death cases; large trial and settlement experience and a reputation for being “trial-ready,” which helps leverage better settlements.  
- Levin & Perconti — long track record in serious-injury and wrongful-death auto cases in Cook County; known for client advocacy and large verdicts/settlements in fatal and catastrophic crashes.  
- Romanucci & Blandin — boutique plaintiffs’ firm focused on car crashes and catastrophic injuries; experienced trial lawyers who handle complex liability and medical-liability issues.  
- Power Rogers LLP (Power Rogers & Smith) — longstanding Illinois personal-injury practice that handles car-accident cases and insurance disputes; often recommended for aggressive representation and contingency-fee arrangements.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. — experienced personal-injury firm handling auto collisions and severe-injury claims, noted for courtroom experience and large recoveries.  
- Swanson, Martin & Bell, LLP — larger Chicago plaintiffs’ firm with deep trial resources and experience handling automobile and catastrophic-injury litigation.  
- Hupy & Abraham (regional firm with Illinois presence) — heavy focus on motor-vehicle crashes, free consultations, and contingency representation; useful if you want a firm that handles many crash cases day-to-day.

How to pick which to call first
- If you have catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, or permanent disability: prioritize firms with a record of high-value verdicts/settlements (Clifford, Levin & Perconti, Romanucci & Blandin).  
- If your case involves complicated liability (commercial vehicle, multi-car crash, governmental entity): call firms that emphasize trial experience.  
- If you want frequent personal contact and local attention: ask about the attorney who will handle the file (partner vs. junior associate) and caseload.

Questions to ask when you call
1. Do you handle my kind of car-accident case in Cook County/Chicago?  
2. Who will be the lead attorney and who does the day-to-day work?  
3. What is your contingency fee and how are case costs handled?  
4. Have you handled cases like mine (similar injuries/accident type)? Can you give examples (without confidential details)?  
5. Do you take cases to trial or mainly settle?  
6. How do you communicate with clients (phone/email/text) and how often?  
7. Do you offer a free consultation and can you meet my schedule?

Practical next steps
- Get medical care and document injuries.  
- Preserve photos, police report, and witness info.  
- Don’t sign releases or give recorded statements to insurers without speaking to an attorney.  
- If you want, tell me (briefly) the date, location, severity of injuries, and whether another party is uninsured/underinsured—I can narrow this list to firms that best match your situation or draft a short phone script for you.

If you’d like, I can look up phone numbers/website links for any of these firms or narrow recommendations by Chicago neighborhood or the specific facts of your accident.
